# GWAS-Linked Bulk RNA-seq and eQTLs

## Objective

Use the same donor genotypes for trait and expression simulation, then assess eQTL recovery against known causal effects.

```r
library(simitall)

simulate_rnaseq_from_gwas(
  genotype_file = "results/gwas/cohort.geno.tsv",
  out_prefix = "results/rnaseq/gwas_linked",
  annotation_gff3 = "results/annotation/genome.gff3",
  n_genes = 500,
  n_cis_eqtl = 50,
  n_trans_eqtl = 20,
  condition_levels = c("control", "stress"),
  batch_levels = c("batch1", "batch2"),
  seed = 404
)

benchmark_eqtl(
  genotype_file = "results/gwas/cohort.geno.tsv",
  expression_file = "results/rnaseq/gwas_linked.expression.tsv",
  sample_metadata = "results/rnaseq/gwas_linked.sample_metadata.tsv",
  truth_file = "results/rnaseq/gwas_linked.eqtl_truth.tsv",
  out_prefix = "results/rnaseq/eqtl"
)
plot_rnaseq_eqtl_results(
  rnaseq_prefix = "results/rnaseq/gwas_linked",
  eqtl_prefix = "results/rnaseq/eqtl",
  out_prefix = "results/figures/gwas_rnaseq"
)
```

## Report

Record donor count, biological replicates, conditions, batch assignment, eQTL architecture, read simulation status, and the causal truth definition.
